android-forms|Multi-line text field.summary: On Android the Plenix multi-line field, and the rich-text editor built on it, is the Material 3 outlined text field with several lines, kept native in behavior (the soft keyboard with a new-line key, selection handles, the text toolbar, the font scale, TalkBack): the Plenix field roles (the control surface, the control border that takes the focus color, the 6-dp control corners) and DM Sans at the body size. It grows a line at a time to its maximum, then scrolls inside. As a rich-text editor its text is a styled string limited to the Plenix formats (bold, italic, links, lists), with a formatting row of Plenix toggle buttons above it; read-only takes the sunken surface.
